scope_events.reason: FR-028 requires the block registry to gain a diagnostic surface, and BlockRegistry lives in blocks/registry/__init__.py rather than _scan.py; the original include named only _scan.py. Also widening to the four test files whose expectations the shared entry-point contract changes.

Audit follow-up: the save-to-library write path bound user_blocks_dir directly in three places, not two. The HTTP route and its collision probe were fixed in scope; the MCP agent tool at ai/agent/mcp/tools_library.py has the identical defect and is reachable from the designed AI tutorial, so a tutorial-project save through the agent would still pollute the user's real library and survive clearing.
